_scoring.note: Scoring covers the 11 sample laws only; calibration laws (2 stored records: 1 correct, 1 wrong; 0 missed; effective dates 2/2) are scored under their own keys.

_classes.name: Court actors left Unspecified (actor_raw names a court, justice, judge or surrogate but agency is Unspecified instead of Unified Court System)
_classes.rule: re.search(r'\bcourts?\b|\bjustices?\b|\bjudges?\b|\bsurrogate', actor_raw, re.I) and agency == 'Unspecified' over duties/*.json + powers/*.json (1 false positive in the matches: 'criminal justice agencies')

_classes.name: Real list items under a mandatory lead-in dropped by designation_no_actor (leaflet content item under 'shall also include'; library added to the DASNY financing list)
_classes.rule: dropped/*.json rule == 'designation_no_actor' AND (another stored record of the same matter_id quotes r'shall (also )?include' [55] OR agency == 'DASNY' [46] OR quote matches r'is amended by adding a new (subdivision|paragraph|clause|subparagraph)' [2]); union reported loosely, all 476 designation_no_actor drops need review against their lead-in

_classes.name: Effective date unparsed for resolvable clauses ('the first of January, 2020'; 'same date as the reversion of ... section 10 of chapter 413 of the laws of 2003')
_classes.rule: effective_dates/*.json rule == 'unparsed' and raw_clause matches r'take effect on the (first|\w+(st|nd|rd|th)) (day )?of (January|...|December),? \d{4}' (1 law) or r'same date as the (reversion|expiration|repeal)' (4 laws); records carrying effective_rule unparsed: 131 (all unparsed laws: 140)

_classes.name: Recipient body taken as actor's group with junk unit (dissolved library resolved to School districts, unit 'Transferred Oswego School District')
_classes.rule: re.match(r'^(Transferred|Awarded|Granted|Paid|Conveyed|Allocated|Distributed|Given)\b', agency_unit) [1]; broader: actor_raw contains 'librar' and agency == 'School districts' [4: 2011-S5157-01, 2013-S2003-01, 2015-S7860-01, ...]
